guarantees.claim: a_q is continuously driven as the XOR of axz0_z1_q and a_mul_ax_b_buf.
b_q is continuously driven as the XOR of bxz0_z1_q and b_mul_bx_b_buf.
A compile-time assertion ensures parameter NPower is either 4 or 2; any other value triggers an elaboration error.

assumptions.claim: Inputs axz0_z1_q and a_mul_ax_b_buf are valid independent first-order domain-oriented shares of the GF multiplication result; similarly bxz0_z1_q and b_mul_bx_b_buf are independent shares.
assumptions.cond: when a_q or b_q are used in downstream masked logic
assumptions.risk: If the shares are not independent or are reused, the XOR may combine correlated masks, breaking first-order side-channel resistance.

uncertain_points.claim: The security of the mask combination (XOR) depends entirely on the upstream stages producing axz0_z1_q, a_mul_ax_b_buf, etc. with proper domain separation. Without examining the generators of these signals, it is unclear if the required DOM independence is maintained.
uncertain_points.risk: A failure in upstream sharing can propagate through this XOR and degrade masking effectiveness without local detection.
